mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the GDP growth is negative, or if the correlation between GDP growth and returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in the last two months signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both proxies show an increase, or if the joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in the last month, coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000, signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease > 0.3% and PAYEMS increase > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month, coupled with a CPI increase of less than 0.1%, signals a disinflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL increase < 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures over two consecutive months signals a strengthening consumer demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending drives economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS shows an increase, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
